message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as hubs:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for American and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Hub for American Airlines; major gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American and Southwest; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; major hub on the East Coast. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest and a key airport for tourism. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Hub for United; major gateway to the Northeast. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, DC | IAD | Hub for United; major airport serving the nation's capital. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and serve as primary hubs for major airlines. They also have extensive international connections and are critical nodes in the U.S. aviation network.
